description: Adaptation Workbook - Explore Climate Impacts Map is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Northern Institute of Applied Climate Science. View climate change impacts for various regions of the United States, compiled from published reports including the 4th National Climate Assessment. Some sections of the Midwest and Northeast have more detailed information about anticipated climate impacts drawn from ecosystem-based vulnerability assessments. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Property. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
